closure_claim: Every tax-exempt interest amount reported in box 8 of a Form 1099-INT furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-INT box 8 only: it says nothing about boxes 1, 3, or 10, Form 1099-DIV box 12, Form 1099-OID tax-exempt sources, premium adjustments, or Form 1040 line 2a completeness. Closed with members authorizes the multi-payer sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form 1099-INT box 8 statement items, tax year 2025
